# Entropy fixtures carved from oracle streams

Payloads here are byte ranges lifted verbatim out of the `cjxl`-produced
fixtures in `JPXL/tests/fixtures/handmade/`. Provenance for each is the
sidecar of the fixture it was carved from, plus the byte range recorded in
the `.expected` file. `cjxl` is used as a black box (AGENTS.md section 2);
no libjxl source was read to produce these.
